description_excerpt: The Analyst, Operations and Process Deployment is part of the Global Product Supply Enablement team and will be responsible for 2 critical job scopes. 1) Own the salesman samples process from the start when the line list is created to the end when the samples are delivered. This role requires the individual to leverage the “One VF” approach in collaborating across multiple regions, brands and functions to drive a standardized process for VF in delivering salesman samples. 2) Lead process improvement work across Apparel brands as project leader.
